skills.name: dependency-injection
skills.description: Wires dependencies for testable code: composition root, constructor injection, narrow ports, injected time and config, fakes. Use when logic news up clients, reads env or time, or a test needs jest.mock.

skills.name: design-patterns
skills.description: Picks a design pattern from a concrete symptom, lighter option first: strategy, factory, adapter, decorator, repository, pipeline, result type. Use when asked "which pattern", for repeated switches or vendor coupling.

skills.name: design-principles
skills.description: Applies SOLID and OOP principles as checks: cohesion, composition over inheritance, YAGNI, functional core. Use when designing classes or modules, "SOLID", "too coupled", "over-engineered", class vs function.

agents.name: design-reviewer
agents.description: Reviews a diff or a set of files for software design problems — tight coupling, god objects, missing dependency injection, leaking vendor types, and also needless patterns and pass-through layers. Read-only. Use when asked to "review the design", "is this over-engineered", "is this too coupled", or before merging a change that adds classes, layers or abstractions.
